story.summaryEn:
Austin, we can't wait to see you.
I / AM comes to Austin with a series of collaborations with the communities who make this city. You. Us. Together.
It begins on the iconic Lady Bird Lake.
Get involved: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/IAM-active
detailZh:
奥斯汀，我们迫不及待想要见到你。
I / AM系列将带着一系列与打造这座城市的社区合作的活动来到奥斯汀。你。我们。一起。
活动将从标志性的Lady Bird Lake开始。
参与活动：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/IAM-active
